title: Calculator
description: A clean, responsive calculator built with React. Features basic arithmetic operations, keyboard support, and a modern minimal UI design.

title: Timer
description: A countdown and stopwatch timer with start, pause, and reset controls. Built with clean HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript.

title: Currency Converter
description: A clean, fully offline currency converter built with React and TypeScript. Supports 20+ major world currencies plus Iranian Toman, with a searchable dropdown, manual exchange rate input, and live-as-you-type conversion.

title: CSS Playground
description: A collection of 31 pure CSS animations — buttons, cards, loaders, motion, text effects, and backgrounds. Copy any snippet and use it anywhere.
